summary: Edit a user from Access Management > Users > pencil > Edit user to change password, email, user type or organization. After upgrading to 2.6, controller admins show as platform administrators and hub admins show as Normal; check the API for auditor privileges.
questions: How do I change a user's password or user type?
Why do hub administrators show as Normal after upgrade?
How do I see if a user had auditor privileges?
